status: Frozen before sequential outcome computation; retrospective audit with prior familiarity with archived data.
primary_question: How many additional one-flight observations are needed for a fixed never-queried combination map, and what comes from prior prediction, query selection, and updates?

direct_combination_protocol.initial_history: Same 18 P11 normal/single trajectories and 30 P13 normal/single outcome records. No AB outcome is initially visible. Existing grey-box parameters use P11 singles only.
direct_combination_protocol.nominal_initialization: Use the already-observed P13 NORMAL initial state of the corresponding family/block for every candidate, not each untested flight's realized initial state.
direct_combination_protocol.outer_splits: All 15 ways of holding out 2 of the 6 AB configurations. Those 2 configurations remain untouched targets at every budget. The other 4 configurations provide 12 queryable archived flights.
direct_combination_protocol.budget: 0 through 12 additional individual-flight reveals. Repeats are revealed one at a time in independently shuffled order. No future seed outcome may be selected.
learners: grey-box prior plus shared outcome-residual update
cheap plan-feature ridge with native sequential refitting
historical suffix lookup with native nearest-combination updates
cheap prior plus the same residual updater
lookup prior plus the same residual updater
query_policies: shared map-variance reduction based on known program coordinates
direct_combination_protocol.decomposition: Budget-zero and frozen-predictor curves isolate initial information; same-query map-directed/random controls isolate updating; policy crossing within each learner isolates selection.
direct_combination_protocol.primary_metrics: Fixed-target flight-level task accuracy and configuration failure-frequency Brier error. No tested configurations enter the evaluation. Height MAE on fixed complete target records is a secondary continuous-map endpoint.
direct_combination_protocol.threshold_reporting: First crossing and persistent crossing are distinguished. Nonattainment within the exhausted pool is reported as such, not extrapolated into a fabricated test count.
direct_combination_protocol.update_kernel: RBF on [direction/30deg, gap/1.45s], length .5, with prior variance1 and noise variance.25 for task. Height uses prior variance.0625 and noise variance.01. Calibration labels are available only after the selected test is revealed; censored height labels do not become exact observations.
direct_combination_protocol.limitation: P13 full synchronized trajectories are not archived. Its sequential update is explicitly output-map calibration, not full dynamics re-identification. A separate P11 trajectory protocol tests shared-parameter updates.

trajectory_identification_protocol.initial_history: 6 P11 normal trajectories, with the same archived P13 single-event outcomes available to endpoint baselines.
trajectory_identification_protocol.queries: Individual P11 A/B trajectories revealed sequentially; source model re-identifies shared dynamics from only observed full trajectories. Unqueried P13 AB is the fixed map target.
trajectory_identification_protocol.goal: Separate the value of shared-parameter updates from the prior-map advantage; do not claim that a P13 outcome-only update reproduces this mechanism.

prohibitions: No labeling censored height prefixes safe
